full_details: At the inn the piece was ten days short of a month. Phillips set Nick under every note, grave and low, and said a whisper in that hall is already a speech. Burbage said he would not look away. You read one line of the prologue and left the next. At night you walked out between the degrees and spoke. Indoors, every hour was night. Pope's Nurse did what my lord had said a nurse would do. Nick held to the dagger, and Burbage did not look away. There was a rustle, and one cough, and then the chair rose. No hush like the Theatre's. A gold button set with five pearls was gone from her kirtle from the time the play began. Sam was on his knees in the rushes with a short candle, and a yeoman's scarlet stood at the edge of the light. He searched the stage-front and under the trestles for half an hour. He did not find it. Nothing glinted. Kemp, aside, said a little gold thing may raise a bigger search than a missing player ever did. Heminges told him to keep it until the inn, down the river, and not to make it a supper story. You were still in the hall at the end of the night.
one_sentence: You spoke the lovers in a hall that was already night, and a boy searched the rushes for the gold button.
title: Spoke the lovers, and Sam searched the rushes
